responsibility: Provides archive-file support for Rust metadata import, largely by adapting GCC’s archive-scanning machinery to feed import streams. It recognizes normal, thin, and AIX big archive formats, reads and interprets member headers and extended names, resolves nested members for thin archives, iterates archive contents, and builds a concatenated Import::Stream from any members whose object data contains Rust export metadata, so archives can serve as containers for importable crate interface data.
